answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to lock a refundable stake bond before it earns rewards, like a walnut shell that only cracks open after proof of real work. Each bond is tied to a unique cipher keypair and a crystal-clear public audit trail of past actions, so one operator spinning up a thousand fake agents must fund a thousand bonds. If any identity is caught attesting falsely, its bond is slashed, turning cheap identity forgery into a direct, measurable financial loss.
